title: StudioBrain execution limits
description: Resource and generation caps honored by every executor type — in-app runtime, backend handlers, and model-manager requests (mapped onto X-SB-* budget/context headers). Tunable in settings and platform.yaml; never hard-coded at call sites (SBAI-7974). Overlay order, later wins: weight-row fields → provider.limits → platform.limits → settings.

max_weights.description: Maximum concurrently loaded weight rows on this surface. Desktop may hold more than a phone.

max_tokens.description: Generation cap per turn. Canonical name for the settings/platform overlay. Weight rows may spell the same fact as max_output_tokens; consumers treat them as aliases (max_tokens wins if both are set and equal; validate.py errors if they disagree).

context_length.description: Context window in tokens. A surface that clamps lower for memory must say so here rather than in executor code.

min_ram_gb.description: Minimum host RAM in GiB for this declaration to be admissible.

min_vram_gb.description: Minimum GPU VRAM in GiB for this declaration to be admissible.

approx_download_mb.description: Approximate download size in MiB. Human-facing; exact byte size lives on weight-row `size`.
